title: The Star Wars Holiday
description: The Star Wars Holiday special was seen once at Thanksgiving in 1978. It seemed too Hollywood, too off the mark in tone and content. But bounty hunter Boba Fett was first introduced, and there was an extended visit with Chewbacca's family. In one concept for the show, Chewie and his son Lumpy try out a virtual reality ride, seen here in sketches by Joe Johnston.
